name: FormSlot
title: codebase memory that tells agents what is already built
summary: FormSlot is the Form family's memory for coding agents: what is already built, where it lives and the rules it follows, served in few tokens. Rust and SQLite, on your machine.
lede: FormSlot is codebase memory for coding agents. It records what is already built, where it lives and the rules it follows, and serves that in as few tokens as the task needs. It is written in Rust on SQLite and runs on your own machine. It has no window of its own: you use it from a terminal, from Claude Code, or in SubForm, where its panel lives.
checks: Names the code your repositories already have as slots, so an agent finds it before writing a second copy.
Reads owner rules, declined approaches and decisions from your repository and recalls them with a source line.
Builds a context pack for a task that fits a token budget you choose, with a byte-stable prefix that caches well.
Answers the CLI, an MCP server on stdio and Claude Code hooks from the same index.

facts.dd: Rust 2024 with two crates, formslot-core and formslot-cli
SQLite bundled through rusqlite, with the system git reading objects at a pinned commit
bm25 and trigram lists fused with the graph, memory and slots, plus a PageRank repo map
formslot eval scores recall over a 147-task gold set in docs/eval

chapters.title: Reuse, not rewrite
chapters.text: A slot is a manifest for code worth reusing, with its files, hashes and every copy found. Drift says which copies are clean, local, behind or diverged.

chapters.title: Rules it remembers
chapters.text: Recall returns ranked records with a token estimate. A pack joins the slots, memory and code excerpts a task needs under your budget.

chapters.title: Agent-ready
chapters.text: The same index answers the CLI, an MCP server on stdio and Claude Code hooks, so every route sees the same store.

features.title: Slots and drift
features.text: A slot is a manifest for code worth reusing.
bullets: Lists its files, hashes and every copy found
Drift reports copies as clean, local, behind or diverged
26 first-load slots ship in data/

features.title: Memory
features.text: Owner rules, declined approaches and decisions are read from your repository and recalled with a source line.
bullets: Recall returns ranked records with a token estimate
formslot recall "seam carving"

features.title: Context packs
features.text: A pack joins the slots, memory and code excerpts a task needs under a token budget you choose.
bullets: The prefix is byte-stable, so it caches well
formslot pack "add a section to the Preferences dialog" --corpus my-repo --tokens 4000

features.title: Ranked search
features.text: bm25 and trigram lists are fused with the graph, memory and slots.
bullets: A PageRank repo map
The dense search tier is opt-in and off by default

features.title: Five languages parsed
features.text: TypeScript, Python, Rust, CSS and HTML are parsed into code units.
bullets: A per-repository call and use graph
formslot add ~/code/my-repo indexes a repository at HEAD

features.title: MCP server
features.text: 9 MCP tools read the same store as the CLI and the Claude Code hooks.
bullets: slot_find, slot_get, slot_source, slot_context_pack and five more
formslot mcp runs on stdio for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
MCP also runs over HTTP

features.title: Claude Code plugin and hooks
features.text: formslot install <repo> writes the plugin files and hooks into a repository.
bullets: A map digest at session start
A reuse and declined-feature check before every write
A duplicate audit at stop
A lookup skill

features.title: On your machine
features.text: The store is local SQLite, and the HTTP service listens on 127.0.0.1.
bullets: FORMSLOT_DATA_DIR moves the data folder from ~/.formslot
FORMSLOT_PORT moves the service port from 5645 (0 picks a free one)

features.title: Evaluated
features.text: formslot eval scores recall over a 147-task gold set.
bullets: Reports are in docs/eval

items: slot suggest proposes new slots from duplicate clusters the store already found
The dense list reorders code units only, so it no longer pushes owner rules and declines out
slot_context_pack reaches the model as text and slot_conventions keeps owner rules
slot_source returns a slot's files at its pinned commit, redacted and capped
Rule slots are native everywhere in search
The repo map is stored per corpus state, so a one-off pack is about a third faster
Search and pack about 3.5x faster from a cached repo map and prepared statements
setup --remove deletes only formslot's own files and never under a running service
